source_extraction_rule.row_selection: data rows only; table header and delimiter rows 121-122 and 140-141 are excluded
source_extraction_rule.cell_parse: split each selected Markdown row into exactly From, Event, and To cells; trim leading and trailing ASCII whitespace from each cell
source_extraction_rule.inline_code_normalization: remove only Markdown backtick delimiter characters from inline-code spans while preserving every enclosed character and all other punctuation, spacing, and capitalization
source_extraction_rule.event_text: the normalized Event cell only; never append or paraphrase any To-cell text
source_extraction_rule.from_states: the normalized state tokens in the From cell, expanded across or/comma alternatives without changing token bytes
source_extraction_rule.to_by_from: a normalized leading To-state token maps every From state to that token; normalized To text beginning unchanged maps every From state to itself
source_extraction_rule.to_qualifiers: qualifiers after the leading To state or unchanged directive remain governed verbatim by the protocol row and are asserted by reason_mapping_assertions; they are never folded into event_text

equivalence_rule: Each event identifier maps one-to-one to one ratified Markdown data row under source_extraction_rule; allowed triples are the mechanical expansion of that row's normalized From and To cells.
